name: Hesperid
body:
Hesperid
CR 9

This beautiful woman has golden hair and a golden tinge in her perfect skin, almost as if the sun’s radiance had condensed in her form.

XP 6,400
LG Medium fey
Init +6; Senses low-light vision; Perception +27; Aura luminous beauty (30 ft.)

DEFENSE

AC 22, touch 22, flat-footed 15 (+5 deflection, +6 Dex, +1 dodge)
hp 109 (15d6+60)
Fort +7, Ref +12, Will +11
DR 5/cold iron; Immune blindness, dazzling effects; Resist fire 5; Weaknesses sunlight dependent

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee sunset ribbon +13/+7 (1d3 +1d6 fire)
Special Attacks blinding flash 8/day (4 rounds, DC 19), nimbus of light 9 rounds/day
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 15th; concentration +20)

Constant—light (self only)
At will—dancing lights, harvest season
8/day—rebuke death (1d4+4)
3/day—beguiling gift (DC 16)
1/day—breath of life

Cleric Spells Prepared (CL 9th; concentration +14)

5th—cleansing fire, flame strikeD (DC 21), sacred nimbus
4th—brightest light, divination, fire shieldD, healing flames (DC 19)
3rd—continual flame, daylightD, glyph of warding (DC 18), prayer, searing light
2nd—burst of radiance (DC 18), calm emotions (DC 17), eagle’s splendor, enthrall (DC 17), heat metalD, sun’s disdain (DC 17)
1st—bless, celestial healing, faerie fireD, positive pulse, protection from evil, sanctuary (DC 16), sun metal
0th—guidance, light, purify food and drink, spark Domains Healing, Sun (Light subdomain)

STATISTICS

Str 10, Dex 22, Con 18, Int 16, Wis 20, Cha 21
Base Atk +7; CMB +13; CMD 23
Feats Agile Maneuvers, Alertness, Combat Casting, Dodge, Flaring Spell, Solar Spell C&C, Spell Focus (evocation), Weapon Finesse
Skills Diplomacy +23, Knowledge (geography, nature) +21, Knowledge (religion) +18, Perception +23, Perform (dance, sing) +27, Sense Motive +27, Use Magic Device +23
Languages Celestial, Common, Sylvan
SQ create golden apple, divine grace, healer’s blessing

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Create Golden Apple (Su)

As a standard action, a hesperid can condense the light around her to create a perfect golden apple.

This functions as an alluring golden apple, except that the target must succeed at a DC 22 Will save to resist its effect. The save DC is Charisma-based.

Divine Grace (Su)

A hesperid adds her Charisma modifier as a deflection bonus to her armor class.

Luminous Beauty (Su)

This ability affects all humanoids within 30 feet of a hesperid. Those who look directly at a hesperid must succeed on a DC 22 Fortitude save or be fascinated for 1d10 rounds. A hesperid can suppress or resume this ability as a free action. The save DC is Charisma-based.

Sunset Ribbon (Su)

At will, an hesperid can harden part of the diaphanous veils she wears to use as a shield or whip, as silk to steelum. When used as a whip, the veil deals an extra 1d6 points of fire damage on a successful hit, as if it had the flaming property. Targets suffer this additional fire damage even if they would not be normally damaged by a whip attack.

Spells Hesperides cast spells as 9th-level clerics and have access to two domains (typically Healing and Sun or any of their subdomains), gaining domain spells and domain powers as normal. They can also swap out prepared spells to cast cure spells as clerics.

Sunlight Dependent (Su)

A hesperid draws her power and health from sunlight. A hesperid that is not exposed to natural light for 24 hours takes 1d6 points of Constitution damage, and another 1d6 points of Constitution damage every day that follows-eventually, this privation kills the nymph. This effect is stopped as soon as the hesperid can see sunlight again.

ECOLOGY

Environment temperate and warm coasts, islands, and oases
Organization solitary or choir (1-10)
Treasure standard

Hesperides are the nymphs of sunset- that is, of paradise, since the lands of the holy were believed to lay where the Sun goes to rest. Daughters of the giant Atlas, who holds the sky on his back, they live on remote islands, isolated coastal cliffsides, and hidden valleys at the edge of the known world.

More similar to celestials than other fey, and much less whimsy and chaotic, hesperides are entrusted by the gods with guarding gardens prohibited to mortals, rich in magical plants and fruits, and precious treasures too dangerous to possess. Though they don’t like fighting, their magic and ability to lure intruders with the enticing lights and golden apples they can create are more than enough to help them in this task, and often they can count on the help of other guardian monsters, summoned or appointed by the deities.

Hesperides are nymphs of sunset, guardians of the colorful golden hues of the setting sun. They live on remote islands, isolated coastal cliffsides, and hidden valleys, all places where the sunset’s golden glow can have the strongest effect.

Hesperides manipulate sunlight with dancelike motions, allowing them to create graceful ribbons of light at close range and searing rays at a distance. Due to their connection to the beauty of the daily cycle of the setting sun, hesperides feel a satisfaction from methodical routine that can feel alien to wilder, more chaotic fey.

While all nymphs protect areas of natural beauty, hesperides often guard other unusual treasures of a more literal variety, sometimes including items long thought lost.

Their steady temperaments and timeless loyalty ensure that they can be trusted to keep whatever they’re protecting safe from harm.
